Name: Cute Beach Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
wow, i haven't uploaded any new maps in a while. i've been really busy. i hope everyone is doing okay despite the craziness in the world. here's a bit of stardew escapism for you — a quiet little beach farm with sand, ocean, forage, and fishing


[b]features[/b]

▹ can replace either the Riverland or Beach farm (Beach by default)
▹ plenty of space along the shore for fishing and crab pots
▹ click on the boats to travel between the mainland and small island


[b]requirements[/b]

▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]
▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
▹ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[b]installation[/b]

1. download the mod and its requirements
2. add "[b][CP] zCute Beach Farm[/b]" folder to [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font]
3. run the game with SMAPI and start a new save on the [b]Riverland[/b] farm


[b]config[/b]

"FarmToReplace": "Riverland" or "Beach"


enjoy x
